options: Any living thing made of cells
questions.explanation: An organism is any living thing - a plant, animal, fungus, or microbe - and all organisms are made of cells.
questions.misconception: Moving does not make something alive (cars move), and organisms include tiny microbes, not just big animals.

questions.prompt: What are all organisms built from?
questions.explanation: Every living thing is made of one or more cells - the basic unit of life.
questions.misconception: Organisms are not built from rocks or metal - cells are the building blocks of all life.

questions.prompt: Which is an activity that living things do?
questions.explanation: Living things grow, use energy, respond to surroundings, reproduce, and stay balanced.
questions.misconception: Living things change and use energy - they do not freeze into one fixed state.

questions.prompt: In ecology, what is the first level in the hierarchy?
questions.explanation: Ecology builds up from the organism, then population, community, and ecosystem.
questions.misconception: The organism is the starting level - ecosystems are built out of organisms, not the other way.
